youtube.aciklama: The Categories of Auditory Performance, or CAP, were described by Archbold and colleagues in 1995. The clinician places the child's everyday auditory ability into one of eight categories, from zero to seven: zero is no awareness of environmental sounds, four is discriminating some speech sounds without speechreading, and seven is using the phone with a familiar talker. Scales only classify roughly; they do not replace detailed language and speech tests.
